activity.notes: This request is normalized to Shutruk-Nakhunte I, the famous 12th-century BCE Shutrukid ruler, not the later Shutruk-Nakhunte II. Middle-chronology reconstructions commonly place his reign around 1184–1155 BCE. He led major campaigns into Mesopotamia and brought monuments such as the Code of Hammurabi stele to Susa.

sources.title: ELAM i. The history of Elam — Encyclopaedia Iranica
sources.citation_text: Encyclopaedia Iranica identifies Shutruk-Nakhunte as founder of the Shutrukid dynasty and records his major campaigns into Mesopotamia and succession before the final fall of the Kassites.
